Content:
## ApiReference

The entity model for an API Reference document. Stored via `IStore<ApiReference>` (singleton scope).

### Namespace
`Cyrena.APIReferences.Models`

### Inheritance
```csharp
public class ApiReference : Entity, IJsonSerializable
```

### Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| `Id` | `string` | Inherited from `Entity`. Unique identifier. Auto-generated if null on save. |
| `Title` | `string?` | **Required.** Title of the API reference document. |
| `Keywords` | `string[]` | Search keywords. Defaults to empty array. |
| `Summary` | `string?` | Brief summary of the reference content. |
| `Link` | `string?` | Optional file linkage (fileId of related source file). |
| `Content` | `string?` | Grounded technical content in plaintext or markdown. |

### Methods

#### `ToJson`
```csharp
public string ToJson()
```
Serializes the entire object to JSON using `Newtonsoft.Json` with indented formatting.

#### `ToString`
```csharp
public override string ToString()
```
Returns `ToJson()` result.

### Storage
Registered as a singleton store in `AssistantPlugin.LoadAsync`:
```csharp
persistence.AddSingletonStore<ApiReference>("api_references");
```

### Usage
```csharp
var reference = new ApiReference
{
    Id = Guid.NewGuid().ToString(),
    Title = "My Service",
    Keywords = ["service", "contract"],
    Summary = "Brief description",
    Content = "## Detailed documentation...",
    Link = "fileId_123"
};
await store.SaveAsync(reference);
```
